# 495: Compare graph binding coverage without constructing a combined owned set

Current assignment: Luna attempt 1. The decision below supersedes historical scheduling records. Root owns Git/GitHub and exact-path checkpoints; no timing or benchmark capture is authorized.

Source inspected at delivered b94da42d9ad20afc0321821067473353a3e30008; crates/graph/src/lib.rs blob b0b66378b85619705998771f681b9c58cfd12e53. This is a queued control-plane maintenance brief, not implementation authorization. Root must number/synchronize and verify the actual eventual base before Luna1. It does not overlap the lane/compressor kernel work and should follow #492 maintenance.

The premise is real: bind_optional_source_set currently constructs supplied, builtin_bank_members, required, source_claim_set and observer pairs, plus all_supplied by cloning supplied and extending with cloned source claims. The combined set is used only for equality against required, twice. The other sets have independent membership/deduplication roles; this brief does not assume they are redundant. GraphPreparedSourceSet::claimed_nodes also allocates a Vec, but removing that is a distinct residual and excluded here.

Smallest product: remove only the combined owned BTreeSet and its key clones. Compute `let coverage_matches = supplied.union(&source_claim_set).eq(required.iter());` at the present all_supplied construction position. Use `!coverage_matches` at the two current `all_supplied != required` sites. BTreeSet union yields ordered unique borrowed keys, exactly the set that clone-plus-extend formed, including overlaps. Keep source_overlap as its separate rejection: coverage equality must not accidentally make overlapping source/node ownership valid. No custom merge algorithm, generic helper framework, collection substitution or new public API is needed.

Preserve construction and evaluation of source_claims_valid, including the existing driver.claim_count call, and all subsequent observer validation. Keep the complete rejection ordering and returned inputs: source mismatch when a source set exists and source validity/overlap/coverage fails; otherwise observer error; otherwise envelope error; otherwise binding error. Duplicate binding detection, builtin-bank member exclusion, structural layout/lowering checks and executor creation stay at their existing positions. No reordering or early-return refactor. Eliminating cloned key storage intentionally changes temporary collection allocation/free activity; it must not move/drop any caller-owned processor, observer, source driver or prepared plan on rejection. Those inputs must remain in the same failure and reusable. No persistent resource/layout accounting field changes: this is transient bind scratch, not retained render memory.

Allowed production/test path: crates/graph/src/lib.rs only, with a compact inline test beside binding_plan/silent_source_set and the existing bind tests. Numbered spec and evidence are allowed. No runtime.rs/program.rs/Cargo/helper/allocator changes. Mechanism acceptance is the exact production diff: no combined owned collection, cloned union keys or replacement allocation; borrowed standard union consumed by equality once and the boolean reused twice. This is a source-level allocation-removal claim, not a measured speedup or a claim that binding becomes allocation-free. A benchmark or new allocator harness is unnecessary for this slice.

Finite directed proof: extend existing fixture construction in one named `binding_coverage_preserves_validation_and_ownership` test. Exercise valid plain coverage; valid split node/source coverage; missing required node; extra unrequired node; overlapping source/node coverage whose union still equals required; duplicate node binding; and empty node/source coverage against a nonempty required set. Assert actual bind outcome and exact rejection code, never just is_err. For source cases retain actual source claims/driver and all returned node bindings after failure; repair the missing/extra case using the returned objects and bind successfully. Add the three priority combinations using these same fixtures: source-coverage mismatch plus bad observer/envelope remains source.graph.binding_mismatch; correct coverage plus bad observer/envelope remains graph.plan.observer; correct coverage/observers plus envelope mismatch remains graph.plan.envelope_mismatch. Use only existing public GraphNodeObserverBinding/processor/source-driver fixture types and locally counted drops if needed to establish no premature owner destruction; do not add production instrumentation. Current builtin-bank exemption is covered by the retained real W4 builtin bind/render test. The source validity predicate itself is unchanged and needs no new validity matrix.

Retain exact existing tests `binding_rejects_duplicates_and_returns_all_ownership`, `identity_binding_acknowledges_without_a_processor`, `structural_layout_rejection_is_shared_after_binding_validation_for_source_families`, `id_ordered_bank_plan_rejects_transactionally_and_returned_ownership_is_reusable`, and `level_major_w4_builtin_bank_is_analytic_for_three_blocks`. These cover duplicate ownership, identity processors, binding-before-layout precedence, repair/rebind, and bank exclusions. Run the new exact inline test with its actual full module path (currently tests:: prefix; verify listing before capture), debug and release, with one nonempty result each. Then `cargo test --locked -p graph --lib` and release equivalent, affected `cargo clippy --locked -p graph --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `git diff --check`, and existing `bash scripts/check-graph-policy.sh`. Retain each real command, source, log and numeric status separately. No timing or broad mutation campaign. A temporary replacement of coverage_matches by true may be used only if a causal discriminator is needed; it must fail the same missing/extra exact-code fixture, not unrelated setup, and be restored before acceptance. It is not mandatory additional machinery.

This is small enough for one coherent maintenance pass. Luna1 implements; Astra adversarial review; Sol2/3 for finite failures, then hardstop/rescope. Source acceptance precedes proportional delivery qualification. Integrate actual delivered main once, verify source identity, and run ordinary artifact verification if required for the production graph edit; any actual mismatch requires a bounded recorded current-artifact ruling, not automatic numeric repins. Actual-head PR review and required CI remain merge gates. Parent349 should record precisely that the redundant combined bind set is removed; residual owned supplied/required/member/claim/observer construction is not silently declared optimized or measured.
